observation.command: sleep 150; echo "=== final verification: all three frontends via shared proxy $(date) ==="; for a in app cms boards; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp_$a.html -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 -H "Host: ${a}.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/ 2>&1); size=$(wc -c < /tmp/resp_$a.html 2>/dev/null); echo "${a}.workspace.localhost -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}, ${size:-0} bytes"; done; echo "=== backend + keycloak via proxy ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "api /health: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/health; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "keycloak /realms/swcode: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode
